question: Can the selective q_is direction enact requested is/was edits as a scalar additive write without using a donor activation, before attempting to identify its upstream gain controller?

novelty_search.nearest_method: The identified q_has writer passed an analogous donor-free target-guided margin-reflection test; no q_is additive actuator or gain has been tested.
novelty_search.nearest_q_is_result: Selective q_is is identified only under rank-one projected interchange, whose coefficient beta reads the donor-base displacement.
novelty_search.new_question: Replace donor projection with a target-guided scalar alpha selected from the base state and fixed is/was output rows, then test held-out construction/lexicon and P/C selectivity.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: q_is and rank one are frozen. The 257-point scalar grid is an actuator calibration instrument, not a rank/compression search; a null cannot raise rank.

frozen_design.budget: 1.25 times the maximum absolute q_is projection coefficient on the first eight v2 A1 calibration rows.
frozen_design.actuator: On a fixed 257-point grid in [-budget,budget], choose the first alpha minimizing absolute error from reflection of the source is/was margin; x'=x+alpha*q_is. Donor activation and donor margin cannot select alpha.
frozen_design.P_semantics: Start from the answer-preserving donor surface and request the opposite tense, scoring margin reflection.
frozen_design.C_semantics: Give the same actuator its strongest target-guided attempt on the unrelated fixed output pair; low normalized movement establishes directional selectivity.
frozen_design.future_use: Only a passing result licenses fitting an upstream local is/was read to alpha; the grid itself is not the final program.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_he: All hashes, both capability screens, basis shape/norm/hash, and exact final-head controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_budget_and_donor_free_actuator: Budget is finite/positive, every alpha is in range, and no confirmation donor activation, donor margin, row outcome, or search outside the fixed grid selects it.
predictions.pred_c_heldout_and_cross_lexicon_A: v2 held-out A1, v2 A2, v3 A1, and v3 A2 mean recovery are each >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_answer_preserving_generalization: v2 and v3 P mean margin reflection are each >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_e_unrelated_output_selectivity: v2 and v3 C normalized movement are each <=0.20.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: Exactly 120 intervention records within 33 forwards/264 examples and 30,840 selected-head grid evaluations; zero transformer backwards or model updates and one calibrated budget scalar.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: q_is supports donor-free selective additive actuation and upstream-controller identification is licensed.
terminal.null: Valid additive actuator misses A/P transfer or C selectivity; retain projected q_is only and do not raise rank.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, head, basis, actuator, or coverage fails.
